messages:
deploy-bot: New release attempt queued: release/2026-03-23-b. Target services: api:v1.14, runtime:v2.3, router:v4.0-beta, console:3.2. Change window starts 02:00 UTC. Interlock ack required in 7m. Runbook: https://internal/release/2026-03-23-b/runbook

jules: ACK. Heads-up: runtime has a memory layout tweak that changes KV hotset behavior. We should cap canary to 1% and run longer (15m) before ramp.

omar: noted. Router team: we can pin 4.0-beta for the wave but need console to confirm header fallthrough is compatible. @tara can you confirm console compatibility test?

tara: I ran quick compatibility locally. Found one failing lint in console thin client unrelated, but header passthrough works. I will push a hotfix if anything surfaces.

sre-bot: Performance smoke scheduled: collector -> staging cluster in 3m. Command: `./scripts/smoke.sh --cluster=staging --client=thin`

jules: rollback criteria proposal: immediate rollback if p99 > 700ms for any 5-minute sliding window OR error rate > 1% sustained 3m. Also abort if KV_eviction_rate > 4% for 2m. Agree?

omar: ack to those sentinels. Add an infra-level guard: if router 4xx increases by +0.5% absolute vs baseline, halt rollout.

tara: +1. I'll stand by to flip console toggle per-canary once runtime is in pinned state. Also predeclare the fallback: console will route to api-stable if header-mismatch detected.

sre-bot: Smoke results (2 runs): run1 p50=110ms p99=260ms errors=0; run2 p50=115ms p99=278ms errors=0. KV_eviction observed 0.9%.

deploy-bot: Canary launch: shard=us-west-2a traffic=1% routes=api(runtime:2.3), router(4.0-beta)

jules: starting monitoring. I'll watch CPU, KV eviction, and chain latency.

sre-bot: Canary metrics @5m: p50=100ms p99=240ms errors=0.1% KV_eviction=1.0% router_4xx_delta=0.0%

omar: good. Please wait for console toggle flip before moving to 5%.

tara: flipping console header-fallthrough ON for canary: `kubectl set env deploy/console HEADER_FALLTHROUGH=enabled --namespace=console-canary`

jules: pin applied: api=v1.14 runtime=v2.3 router=v4.0-beta. I updated release notes draft with KV notes + rollback rules: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2026-03-23-b

sre-bot: Traffic shift -> 5% initiated. Metrics update: p50=105ms p99=255ms errors=0.15% KV_eviction=1.4% router_4xx_delta=+0.01%

omar: small upward tick but within threshold. Hold for 10m and re-evaluate.

jules: placing manual hold to await 10m telemetry. To continue: `deploy-bot continue 1762429999` or react :white_check_mark:.

tara: leaving note: console fallback ready if router misbehaves. Will trigger manual rollback to api-stable on signal.

sre-bot: Manual hold acknowledged. Auto-advance disabled. If any sentinel trips, deploy-bot will rollback and post to #incidents with runbook link.

jules: thanks all. Will lift hold if next 10m looks steady.
